items.areas: Anchorage; Lower Matanuska Valley; Southern Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley
items.instruction:
A dense fog advisory means visibilities will frequently be reduced to
less than one quarter mile. If driving, slow down, use your
headlights, and leave plenty of distance ahead of you.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 14 at 4:07AM AKST until November 16 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 6 AM AKST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will begin to increase during the day
Saturday, reaching at least 40 mph during the evening timeframe.
Expect winds to shift southwesterly Sunday night.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

snow accumulations 2 to 5 inches are expected.

* WHERE...Haines Highway, Klukwan to Haines Customs

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will likely become slick and hazardous.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 13 at 3:20PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Moderate snow and winds are expected in the Eastern Brooks Range
from Saturday morning through Saturday night. Total snow
accumulations could range between 2 and 5 inches during this time.
Wind gusts to 35 mph could produce areas of blowing and drifting
snow. Travel may become difficult throughout this period.
